NAM Kasaragod Data Entry Operator Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for NAM Kasaragod Data Entry Operator Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the National Ayush Mission Kasaragod (NAM Kasaragod) for filling up vacant posts on a contract basis under the district program management and support unit.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post announced in this notification?
faq.answer: The notification has been released for the recruitment of the Data Entry Operator post to handle administrative and computer-based official duties at the district level.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available under NAM Kasaragod Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 1 vacancy has been officially announced for the Data Entry Operator position under this recruitment notification issued by the National Ayush Mission Kasaragod.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is completely through Walk-in Interview. Eligible candidates do not need to send any online or offline advance applications.

faq.question: Q5. What is the date of the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Data Entry Operator post is scheduled to be held on 08-10-2026. Candidates must report to the venue on time with all required documents.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required for the Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess Any Graduation along with a Government Approved DCA or PGDCA course from a recognized institution to be eligible for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for applying to this position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 40 years. Candidates must verify their age eligibility as per the official guidelines before attending the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the monthly salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates appointed as Data Entry Operators will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 14,175/- as per the guidelines of the National Ayush Mission.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for attending the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category including General, OBC, SC, and ST candidates. It is completely free of cost to attend the walk-in selection process.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original educational certificates, mark sheets, DCA/PGDCA certificates, proof of age, identity proof, and self-attested photocopies along with passport-size photographs.
